item.title: Lights for people using bikes stuck on red, 17th November
item.description:
The detector at the lights for people travelling eastbound on bicycles at the junction immediately before the left turn onto City Road and straight ahead for Old Street East, frequently fails to detect people using bicycles or cancels detection while they are still waiting. This is an extremely serious danger as it is causing cyclists who justifiably determine the lights are broken to cross against the lights risking a left hook from vehicles turning onto City Road. The person who was at the lights before me had sat through three cycles of the lights without being detected and given authority to proceed. This needs fixing to ensure that there are no more false negatives. If detection without false negatives can’t be achieved reliably, the detector should be removed and the phase for people using bikes should never be skipped.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Old Street Roundabout, Hoxton, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
